title: Truncated docstring at top of session_snapshot_restore.ts
body: The module docstring in src/world/session_snapshot_restore.ts breaks off mid-sentence: 'The world content hash remains useful provenance, but a' — the clause has no completion, and the next line starts a new sentence ('Content-only mismatches preserve history...'). This is the first thing a reader hits when deciding how save compatibility works, so the lost clause is load-bearing. Comment-only fix; no behavior change.
